description: Set up the corpus handoff lugh consumes (docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md): publish the regenerable build/corpus as a versioned, private release artifact (tarball + sha256), since DVC is gone (docs/artifact-versioning.md Option C). This is the producer side of the pinakes->lugh corpus seam. Independent of 90 (a consumer just needs the artifact to exist before it pulls real data).

userStories.title: Deterministic corpus packaging script
userStories.description: A script that packages build/corpus (nodes/ + edges/) into a versioned tarball with a recorded sha256, reproducibly.
acceptanceCriteria: A tooling script tars build/corpus into corpus-<version>.tar.gz and writes its sha256; re-running on the same corpus yields the same sha256 (deterministic ordering, pinned mtimes).
The script is documented in docs/artifact-versioning.md as the pinakes->consumer corpus handoff, and it no-ops with a clear message when build/corpus is absent (regenerate first).
A test drives it over a tiny fixture corpus and asserts tarball + sha256 are produced and stable.

userStories.title: Publish + pull contract
userStories.description: Wire publishing the tarball as a private GitHub release asset, and document the authenticated pull consumers (lugh) use.
acceptanceCriteria: A CI/release path uploads corpus-<version>.tar.gz as a private release asset (or the chosen object store), keyed to a corpus version.
docs/artifact-versioning.md documents the authenticated `gh release download` (or object-store) pull + sha256 verification that lugh's LUGH_CORPUS_DIR setup performs.
